district_name: Southwest Vermont Regional Technical School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: the Southwest Vermont Regional Technical School District (district no. V009), a standalone regional technical (CTE) district under 16 V.S.A. ch. 37, subchapter 5A, serving 14 towns in the Bennington region.
Southwest Vermont Regional Technical School District / Southwest Tech (official site).

board.post_note: SWVRTSD: eleven directors elected at-large by the whole service region's voters by Australian ballot, 3-year terms (governance-plan By-Laws Art. III). No appointed seats exist. Seats carried as seated; a fourth seat warned in 2026 is held -- see the board sources.

sources.note: SWVRTSD official 2026-27 Regional Governing Board roster (district document, fetched 2026-10-22): Cutler (Chair), Edelson, Johnson, Kinney, Orzehowski (Clerk), Randall, Sauer, Swierad (Vice-Chair), West, Wheeler, Williams. Under the district's governance-plan By-Laws (Art. III sections 1-3) EVERY director is elected at-large by the district's voters by Australian ballot for 3-year terms (the Nominations Committee only nominates) -- this district has NO appointed seats. Randall, Sauer and Wheeler's ends are DERIVED: the Bennington town clerk's certified March 3, 2026 results declare all three elected (Sauer 2,725; Randall 2,636; Wheeler 2,520) and all terms are 3 years -- the derivation is stated here; the other eight members' election years are published in no fetched official source (resolving documents: the district's 2024/2025 certified returns). HELD: a fourth seat was warned for March 3, 2026 ("4 to be elected") but the certified return declares only three -- its disposition is undocumented (resolving documents: the March 2026 warning and post-election board minutes). The By-Laws fix no board size (set by the unlocated Governance Planning Committee Report); seats are carried as the seated roster presents (11).
